hero.lede: Clutch bricks grip like they mean it. Scroll to build Launchpad 01, one brick at a time.

builder.body: Pick a color and a size, then tap the baseplate to drop a brick. Tap on top of a stack to keep building up. Drag to turn it around.

specs.body: That click is a tolerance problem. Every Clutch brick is molded to the same numbers, so a brick from 2026 grips one from 2046.

items.text: Stud pitch. The distance from one stud to the next.
Brick height. Three plates make one brick.
Mold tolerance. Thinner than a hair, by a lot.
Connections tested per mold before it ships.

sets.body: The rocket from the top of this page, in three colorways. Every brick in the box, nothing glued.
sets.name: Launchpad 01

footer.fine: Clutch is a made-up brand for a concept site. Not affiliated with any toy company.
